name: British Virgin Islands
say: Steady trade winds, flat blue water between green islands, and a beach bar at the end of every passage
data: Wind: recorded, NOAA's hourly RTMA analysis for 9 and 10 February 2025, with the wind shadow under the high islands added by rule. Tide and stream: recorded, NOAA's global tide model (STOFS-2D-Global) for the same hours. Depths are that model's, with Colquhoun Reef charted by hand. Anegada is off the chart.
